h: Castles, Romans and the High Street
p: You're on the High Street of one of England's most historic towns here. Colchester was the Roman capital of Britain, and the Norman castle, now a cracking museum, sits in Castle Park right off the High Street, only a few minutes' walk away.

That makes it easy to fit a bit of history in around everything else. Firstsite, the contemporary art gallery, is close by, and the Mercury Theatre is just across the town centre. Admiral itself is an adults-only gaming centre, strictly 18+, so it's not part of the family plan, but the High Street and the lanes around it are packed with cafés, pubs and restaurants for when you want to sit down and refuel.
